YOUR ITINERARY / YOUR PACE

An hourly chauffeur booking gives a planned itinerary one consistent thread. A hotel departure, a sequence of meetings, a lunch reservation or an evening with several destinations can be discussed as a connected journey. It is a useful choice when the day involves more than a single transfer.

The supplied listings show one-hour appointments for Luxury Sedan, Luxury SUV and Luxury Sprinter. Share the full start and finish, the order of stops and the time you need at each destination. Additional hours, waiting, route changes and service arrangements require confirmation with the company.

01

Plan the sequence

Write down the actual order of addresses, with appointment or reservation times. A clear sequence helps establish the time the vehicle will be required.

02

Keep the occasion in view

A business itinerary and an evening out have different pacing. Tell us which arrival times are fixed and which parts of the day can remain flexible.

03

Confirm the full booking

Discuss the total duration and expected finish before booking. A one-hour listing should not be treated as an unlimited period of vehicle availability.

BEFORE YOU TRAVEL

Useful details.

Can I reserve more than one hour?

Contact the company with the duration you need. Additional availability, the appropriate booking and the final price should be confirmed before you reserve.

Will the chauffeur wait between stops?

Discuss waiting requirements as part of the itinerary, including how long each appointment may take. Waiting and additional time are subject to the arrangements confirmed by the company.

Can an hourly journey finish at ATL?

Include the airport as the final destination, with your flight details and any luggage collection stop. The company can confirm the appropriate service and timing for the complete journey.
